case_name: Frontier HPC waste heat and ORNL campus demand pathway
data_resolution: Nominal 10-minute source-side measurements for calendar year 2023
decision_reason: Best direct fit to conserved waste-heat allocation: measured quantity and grade are linked to a public heat-pump engineering assessment and nearby campus demand
limitation: No measured time-resolved receiving-demand series is public; the report provides a 1-2 MW demand range and annual scenario results

data_resolution: 15-minute heat load and feed/return temperatures for seven plants, 2016-2019
decision_reason: Provides an independent open demand/network-temperature series for checking storage and dispatch behavior without duplicating the data-center source class
limitation: Not a counterfactual waste-heat-rejection case and therefore cannot substitute for the primary Frontier analysis

case_name: NREL ESIF hybrid air/liquid-cooled HPC system
data_resolution: One-minute supply temperature, return temperature, and cooling power over 12 months
decision_reason: Strong measured source profile and engineering context, retained as a possible source-side sensitivity
limitation: Repository-level reuse terms and a time-resolved receiving-demand series were not confirmed

case_name: Katri Vala wastewater and district-cooling heat-pump plant
data_resolution: Hourly citywide district-heat demand; public plant capacity and source description
decision_reason: Open demand data and a documented large heat-pump receiving pathway make this a useful contextual comparator
limitation: Public source data do not isolate an hourly plant-level recoverable-heat stream

case_name: Meta data-center surplus heat to Fjernvarme Fyn
data_resolution: Public design capacity and annual heat-delivery statements
decision_reason: Operational data-center heat recovery provides a strong engineering analogue for interpreting the Frontier case
limitation: No auditable time-resolved source or demand profile was identified

data_resolution: Public seasonal source temperatures, capacity, COP range, and annual/full-load context
decision_reason: Well-documented real heat-pump system with useful technology ranges
limitation: No public hourly wastewater flow, source heat, or receiving-demand series was identified

data_resolution: Public source-temperature range and plant/storage/network capacities
decision_reason: Operational metro waste-heat recovery covers a requested source class and documents a finite local network pathway
limitation: No open time-resolved tunnel heat-source or demand data were identified

case_name: MultiPACK CO2 supermarket refrigeration and heat recovery
data_resolution: Field measurements for representative days plus one-year energy summaries
decision_reason: Open field evidence covers refrigeration rejection, on-site heat demand, and integrated thermal service
limitation: The public record does not provide a continuous full-year source-and-demand time series at the same detail as Frontier or Sønderborg

case_name: US thermoelectric generation and cooling-water reporting
data_resolution: Monthly cooling-water data and monthly generation/fuel data; hourly emissions and load available for covered units from EPA CAMD
decision_reason: National public reporting can support a separate large-scale thermal-discharge study
limitation: Recoverable heat grade and a credible receiving-demand pathway cannot be reconstructed consistently without plant-specific engineering data

case_name: Danish Energy Producer Census public surplus-heat subset
data_resolution: Annual supplier/system/municipality context for the public 2021-2023 subset
decision_reason: Provides transparent national context for industrial surplus-heat uptake
limitation: Annual aggregation lacks source temperature, hourly availability, and dispatch data

case_name: Wastewater-source heat-pump case at Gorzyce treatment plant
data_resolution: Published daily/monthly operating observations and modeled system quantities
decision_reason: Recent case evidence provides source-temperature and flow context
limitation: The underlying operational dataset and all required techno-economic inputs were not found as an independently downloadable open dataset
